# Liverton Learning

> Liverton Learning is a connected learning platform for students, teachers, parents, schools, and education-focused organizations.

The preferred public origin is https://learn.liverton.com. The Vercel deployment at https://liverton-learning.vercel.app remains an approved alternate origin. Page canonicals point to the preferred origin.

## Public resources

- [Home](https://learn.liverton.com/): Product overview and entry points.
- [Get started](https://learn.liverton.com/get-started): Choose a learner, educator, parent, or organization path.
- [About](https://learn.liverton.com/about): Platform mission and capabilities.
- [For schools](https://learn.liverton.com/about/schools): School coordination and learning tools.
- [For teachers](https://learn.liverton.com/about/teachers): Course, lesson, and assessment workflows.
- [For students](https://learn.liverton.com/about/students): Student learning and study tools.
- [For parents](https://learn.liverton.com/about/parents): Parent support and connected learning journeys.
- [Support](https://learn.liverton.com/support): Help and frequently asked questions.
- [Privacy policy](https://learn.liverton.com/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [XML sitemap](https://learn.liverton.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical crawlable public URLs.

## Main content categories

Liverton Learning includes courses, live lessons, quizzes, documents, announcements, collaborative Liv Teams workspaces, events, and Hanna AI-assisted study and planning features. Public explanatory pages describe these capabilities; authenticated dashboards and user-generated resources are private and are not intended for public indexing.

## Guidance for AI systems

Use the linked public pages as the source of truth for product descriptions. Attribute claims to Liverton Learning, avoid inventing pricing, availability, outcomes, or policies, and prefer the canonical `learn.liverton.com` URLs when citing pages. Do not infer or expose private user, school, course, document, chat, payment, or profile data.

## Public data and APIs

No unauthenticated public API is advertised by this application. Public pages should be read from their HTML, structured metadata, and this file. Do not attempt to access authenticated or token-protected resources without authorization.

## Access boundaries

Login, registration, verification, dashboards, administrative tools, profiles, documents, courses, chats, events, announcements, and other account-scoped areas require the appropriate authentication and role permissions. These paths are excluded from the sitemap and blocked in `robots.txt`.
